title: Mixed Duo #033 · 여 사이렌 바스트 아워글래스·페르시안글램 / 남얼굴 바이올린 힙 아워글래스·실버 포일
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind her, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Iranian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on brass chain (a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a copper square-sided cowbell, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bronze round bell, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver rings. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Iranian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a sleek male idol face with a straight nose, a sharp jawline, thick brows and cool intense eyes, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, olive skin with a warm undertone, a confident smirk, vivid copper-orange hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a tin hammer head, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold anklets. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black combat boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
